notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer and Leaden Myr do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Leaden Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Leaden Myr.
Ashnod triggers, copying Teardrop Kami's ability, targeting Leaden Myr.
Resolve the first Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Leaden Myr.
Activate Leaden Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Resolve the second Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Leaden Myr.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Teardrop Kami.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.
